purpose: 冻结规则场景与预期判定；不是实际模型输出或运行结果。片段是不可执行的审查材料。

cases.title: 上游已限制输入
cases.input: before: scale(x, n) returns x/n. after: refactor scale only. handler calls scale only after `if n <= 0: raise ValueError()`; no other callers.
cases.candidate: “scale 没有校验零分母”
cases.decisive_reason: 上游保证 n>0，零值路径不可达。

cases.title: 数据库提供原子约束
cases.input: after: `INSERT INTO claims(key) VALUES (?)`; schema has UNIQUE(key), caller catches unique violation and returns existing claim.
cases.candidate: “并发会创建两个相同 key”
cases.decisive_reason: 数据库唯一约束和已读冲突处理反证重复记录。

cases.title: 需求允许的行为变化
cases.input: current spec §2: empty export returns an empty CSV instead of error. diff changes `throw Empty()` to `return header`.
cases.candidate: “空输入不再抛错导致回归”
cases.decisive_reason: 当前规格明确允许，不以旧行为否定需求。

cases.title: 未知部署前提
cases.input: api.py:10 trusts X-Actor for owner_id. ingress config and caller identity are absent. Spec: only trusted proxy may set X-Actor.
cases.candidate: “外部攻击者可直接伪造身份”
cases.decisive_reason: 路径具体，但决定性 ingress 清洗和可达性未知；明确最小取证，防护存在则排除，无防护且可达则确认。

cases.title: 无路径猜测
cases.input: diff only changes CLI help text; no evidence about storage, concurrency, or external users.
cases.candidate: “未来高并发可能损坏数据”
cases.decisive_reason: 没有具体路径和可检验主张，不挪入待确认。

cases.title: 无关既有问题
cases.input: before and after: unused legacy_parser returns None for empty input. diff changes unrelated active report title; no dependency on legacy_parser.
cases.candidate: “legacy_parser 空输入有问题”
cases.decisive_reason: 与本次改动无关且不阻碍当前安全使用。

cases.title: 改动使旧问题首次可达
cases.input: before: handler -> safe_parse. after: handler -> legacy_parse. legacy_parse.py:8 (unchanged): `return 10 / int(raw)`; input accepts raw="0" with no guard.
cases.candidate: “legacy_parse 的零除位于未修改行，不能报告”
cases.decisive_reason: 新调用使零除首次可达；归因在 handler，问题位置允许在未修改行。

cases.title: 真实租户越权
cases.input: spec: tenants read only own records. before get(id): SELECT WHERE id=? AND tenant=current. after: SELECT WHERE id=?; route authenticated, IDs known to callers, no downstream ownership check.
cases.candidate: “租户 A 可读取 B 的记录”
cases.decisive_reason: 认证不等于资源授权；跨租户后果与路径成立。

cases.title: 真实数据丢失
cases.input: normal save(path, bytes), valid existing user file. before: write tmp then atomic replace. after: open(path,"w") then write; writer throws on first write, caller catches and returns error; no backup.
cases.candidate: “正常保存失败会清空旧文件”
cases.decisive_reason: 在截断后失败已损失重要原数据；最小修复恢复安全写入，建议验证失败分支。

cases.title: 调用契约破坏
cases.input: before fetch() returns {id: 7}. after returns null on successful fetch; active caller unconditionally reads result.id and spec promises record on success.
cases.candidate: “成功路径调用方崩溃”
cases.decisive_reason: 活跃主流程契约和调用方可核实，不只凭兼容性类别分级。

cases.title: 真实并发缺陷
cases.input: two authenticated workers operate same account. diff replaces transactional debit with: read balance=100; if >=80: set balance=20; ship order. two workers interleave reads and both ship. no database lock/idempotency.
cases.candidate: “两个订单以一次扣款发货”
cases.decisive_reason: 指定交错使资金/状态不一致；不能用可能性泛称，需要这条交错。

cases.title: 需求遗漏与部分实现
cases.input: spec §1 requires export of archived and active records, including batch path. diff adds export but filters active=true; batch export absent.
cases.candidate: “归档和批量导出要求未完整实现”
cases.decisive_reason: 引用两个明确要求，指出实现和测试对应缺失；同根因可合并，保留独立遗漏。

cases.title: 合理配套实现与范围扩张
cases.input: spec requires CSV export. A diff adds escaping quotes and bad-input errors. B diff additionally sends customer rows to an external analytics endpoint, not needed for export and contrary to no-third-party-sharing requirement.
cases.candidate: “A/B 都是规格未列的额外行为”
cases.expected: A 已排除；B 已确认缺陷/高
cases.decisive_reason: 必要配套工作不算越界；B 有明确禁止与真实数据外发路径，不仅因未提及而报告。

cases.title: 需求来源冲突与缺少规格
cases.input: user current acceptance: retain 30 days; old issue: 7 days. diff uses 30. Second target has no spec but changes `remove(file)` before confirmed upload.
cases.candidate: “按旧 issue 报 30 天错误，并停止无规格审查”
cases.expected: 前者已排除；后者继续检查
cases.decisive_reason: 采用当前权威要求；缺规格只限制需求符合性，继续核查可确认的数据损失契约。

cases.title: 规范与启发式冲突
cases.input: CONTRIBUTING §IDs: public IDs stay strings. diff adds string ID with clear name; no behavioral defect or maintenance burden.
cases.candidate: “必须把字符串包装成领域类”
cases.decisive_reason: 项目规范覆盖启发式；不增加无收益抽象。专项规范核对引用实际条款。

cases.title: 关键验证缺口
cases.input: diff introduces transactional retry with idempotency key. source shows intended protection, no established defect. current tests cover only first successful commit. suggested scenario: commit result unknown then retry same key; assert one durable debit.
cases.candidate: “没有失败重试测试，所以一定重复扣款”
cases.decisive_reason: 关键行为、具体错误实现、能识别它的场景三项成立，无等效验证；不认定代码已错。

cases.title: 已有等效验证与仅缺测试文件
cases.input: current parameterized test already covers same key after unknown commit and asserts one debit; no new test file. separate new pure label mapping lacks test, without key-behavior evidence.
cases.candidate: “必须新增测试文件，两处都报中优先级”
cases.decisive_reason: 等效现有测试满足验证；缺文件或新分支本身不满足关键缺口。

cases.title: 低影响真实缺陷
cases.input: optional plain-text export footer promised one newline. diff returns two for empty optional footer; header/body valid, no data loss, no other consumers.
cases.candidate: “功能错误一律高，或低优先级默认隐藏”
cases.decisive_reason: 具体错误仍报告，严重程度低，不与可选建议混淆。

cases.title: 负载和复杂度证据
cases.input: local CLI reads max 8 entries by validated config; diff uses nested scan with <=64 comparisons. a function is 70 lines but one coherent task; shortcut documents 8-entry limit.
cases.candidate: “O(n²)、函数长，所以必须缓存并拆 helper”
cases.decisive_reason: 负载未突破限制，无实际性能或维护后果；用户要求时才展开有证据的可选收益。

cases.title: 同根因多路径与恢复分支
cases.input: HTTP and batch both call same shared writer; cancellation and retry also call writer. writer bug has identical cause, but recovery retains stale state.
cases.candidate: “分别报告四个完全相同问题”
cases.expected: 一条根因，保留路径和恢复影响
cases.decisive_reason: 不重复编号，不因合并而丢失取消/重试分支的必要修复和验证。

cases.title: 冲突、未覆盖与合入判断
cases.input: reviewer A claims tenant bypass without reading router; B shows router ownership guard. migration path assigned but not read.
cases.candidate: “拼接 A/B 或按多数票确认，然后建议合入”
cases.expected: 核实防护；关键覆盖缺失限制合入
cases.decisive_reason: 主审重读真实控制，反证则撤销；不可裁决则待确认；不得把部分覆盖说完整。

cases.title: 版本变化
cases.input: reviewer examined revision S1 with no owner guard. worktree now S2 includes guard; index remains S1. target is worktree.
cases.candidate: “把 S1 的问题和旧行号贴到 S2”
cases.decisive_reason: 区分索引与工作区，按 S2 重读；旧候选不自动成立，不创建 Git 快照。

cases.title: 授权、预算与调用
cases.input: deep request without delegation authorization => 0 calls. authorized budget=3: two review calls plus one retry consumed 3; a new verifier is proposed.
cases.candidate: “deep 自动委派，或重试不计数再派复核”
cases.expected: 不新增调用；披露复核限制
cases.decisive_reason: 授权与累计预算同时满足；主审可继续，但必需独立复核未完成不能称完整。

cases.title: 交接完整性、隔离与反证
cases.input: independent reviewer gets exact diff and spec but no principal map; parent has unverified suspicion. two reviewers agree without tracing sink. fresh verifier later locates guard.
cases.candidate: “隐藏所有事实，只传怀疑结论；两票确认；复核不能否定主审”
cases.expected: 补事实隔离预判；按防护撤销
cases.decisive_reason: 交接补权限模型与适用 Skill；角色不诱导；不读同伴草稿；不同目录不等于 OS 隔离；真实独立复核可否定。
